text: XPEL, Inc. is a listed company; per its 2026 proxy statement the beneficial owners of more than 5% of its common stock are BlackRock (14.6%), Wasatch Advisors (13.8%), The Vanguard Group (5.3%), Alta Fox Capital Management (5.2%) and director Richard K. Crumly (5.1%, an individual investor on the board since 2010).
short: XPEL is Nasdaq-listed; its >5% holders are BlackRock, Wasatch, Vanguard, Alta Fox and director Richard Crumly (5.1%).

source.name: XPEL, Inc. 2026 Proxy Statement (DEF 14A, SEC EDGAR)
source.quote: Certain Beneficial Owners: BlackRock, Inc. (1) 3,906,962 14.6% Wasatch Advisors, LP (2) 3,814,500 13.8% The Vanguard Group (3) 1,475,149 5.3% Alta Fox Capital Management LLC (4) 1,438,831 5.2% Directors and Executive Officers: Stacy L. Bogart 7,934 * Richard K. Crumly (5) 1,414,489 5.1%
source.note: Contiguous rows of the proxy's 'Security Ownership of Certain Beneficial Owners and Management' table. The proxy also states: 'Mr. Crumly is also a beneficial owner of approximately 5.1% of our common stock.'
